headline: Is Adobe (ADBE) Still Trading At A Discount After Its July Software Sector Rebound?
summary: The broad software sector rebound in July, led by strong gains in several peers, has put fresh attention on Adobe (ADBE) as investors reassess sentiment toward large software platforms. See our latest analysis for Adobe. Adobe’s recent 30 day share price return of 14.39% suggests some momentum is returning after a year to date share price decline of 24.59% and a 1 year total shareholder return that fell 25.80%, keeping the longer term picture subdued.
